newsitem.title: POLAND: RESEARCH ALERT- Pekao rates Agros "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Pekao rates Agros "buy".

text.p: CBM Pekao SA brokerage issued a buy recommendation for Agros Holding SA saying the shares of the food trading and processing company remained undervalued despite its strong gains over the last year.
It said in a note to investors dated July 4 and released to the media on Wednesday earnings growth prospects of Agros for 1997-1999 warranted its buy recommendation.

"Despite a significant appreciation over the last 12 months we believe that the company is currently undervalued considering our earnings forecasts for the Agros group in 1997-1999," Pekao analysts said.
The note did not give Pekao's forecasts.
It said Agros had one of the most transparent structures among Warsaw bourse's holding groups and its restructuring plan would allow it to become a leading Polish food producer.
On July 4 Agros traded at 88.5 zlotys while on Wednesday it closed at 88 zlotys.
